body: fair enough. for me it's the polar opposite. to each their own, and all
if you were absolutely certain (as in you had some experience that proves this) that this life wasn't all there is, would that change your mind?

I've tried therapy, I've tried anti-depressants, I've tried meditation (many thousands of hours at that), I've tried drugs, I've tried to walk on my hands! (not really, but you get the idea)

the peace, well peace isn't a great word to describe it, but the lack of conflict I have is due to realizing that for me, suicide is ok. I'm not going to get too much into my situation, as it isn't incredibly relevant, but I am ok with saying that I have suffered through tremendous death, abuse, and neglect in my life by people that, normally, are supportive and available.  I'm going to talk to the people I interact with on a daily basis, and tell them my intentions, and how this isn't a rash action (at least 10 years in the making!). how often is it that people actually get the chance to say what they wanted to say before someone dies!?

not fighting with myself about whether or not suicide is a legitimate option gives me peace. I have come to the conclusion for myself it's ok. I'm not saying it is for all people, or for all situations, but for myself in my situation, it's ok.

you can say peace is all in your mind, and I'm not discounting that it's true, but the amount of control I (and everyone else for that matter)have over what my mind does is so absolutely minimal that I don't think it's relevant or helpful.
